title: Food Delivery
description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.

mainQuestExcel.title: Food Delivery
mainQuestExcel.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.

flow.stepDescription: Talk to Sara at Good Hunter

dialogs.text: Order for delivery
Traveler! Perfect timing...
Sorry, I know you must be hungry, but could you do something for me?
There's been a steady increase in volume of delivery orders recently. I tend to divide them up by region and then label each dish with the name of the person who ordered it.
But I've lost the label for this <color=#00E1FFFF>Calla Lily Seafood Soup</color>. All I know is that it's for someone in Springvale.
Could you take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Calla Lily Seafood Soup</color> over to Springvale for me and find out who ordered it?
I guess, but...
Rest assured there'll be a hearty meal waiting for you on your return!
I'm counting on you!
I only came here to eat; I'm starving!
Once you've done what I ask, I'll treat you to something from the Good Hunter special menu! Much obliged.

I did! ...Oh, but this one isn't mine.

Um... is it Calla Lily Seafood Soup?

Ugh, whatever. Here's your money. Now get outta here, let me eat my food in peace.

Well, I guess good food is also a treasure worth waiting for. I'm sure I've got time to eat before treasure hunting.
Thank you. Here's the cash.
Takeout, get your takeout here...
Takeout? Not mine.

flow.stepDescription: Deliver the food to the buyer

You're back! Did you manage to deliver it?
Here's the fee.
Let me check... Perfect! Thanks!
Here, this <color=#00E1FFFF>Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake</color> is for you. It's fresh out of the oven, eat it while it's hot.
Once I've finished eating I can get on with my adventure...
